issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Farm to use a List<Animal> implemented with an ArrayList and to initialize the ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the reference solution uses a Queue<Animal> backed by a LinkedList (java.util.Queue and java.util.LinkedList). This is an attribute/type mismatch for the Farm.animals collection. Students reading the problem will be instructed to use List/ArrayList, while the solution/reference uses Queue/LinkedList, which can cause confusion about the expected type for the getter/setter and the internal implementation and could lead to mismatches with automated checks or instructor expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent across artifacts. Either update the solution to use the specified type: declare animals as List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() (adjust imports and getter/setter signatures accordingly), or change the problem statement and any instructions/tests to accept Queue<Animal>/LinkedList. Preferably align the solution with the problem statement by using List<Animal> and ArrayList to avoid confusing students.
